parole.testo: Probably related to Dutch botsen (“to collide”), both borrowed from German butzen, from Middle High German butzen, from Old High German bōzan, from or related to Proto-West Germanic *bautan (“to beat”).

From German Gift (“poison”), from Middle High German gift f (“gift, present”), Old High German gift f (“gift”), from Proto-West Germanic *gifti, from Proto-Germanic *giftiz, which is a derivation of *gebaną (“to give”).
